# Windsor Furnace Repair

> Serving Windsor and the wider Essex County region, Windsor Furnace Repair is a home comfort contractor covering furnace repair, air conditioner service, ductless installation, heat pumps, fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning for Ontario homeowners.

Phone: (548) 708-8221  |  Email: contact@windsorfurnacerepair.ca  |  Website: https://windsorfurnacerepair.ca

Service areas: Windsor, LaSalle, Tecumseh, Amherstburg, Leamington, Lakeshore, Belle River, Essex
